module.Chapter: Chapter 5 · Functions, Files, and Raspberry Pi
module.Title: Check Different Readings
module.Teaching: A parameter receives a value when the function is called, allowing one function to evaluate many readings.
module.PredictionQuestion: What is value inside the function?
PredictionOptions: The argument supplied by the caller
module.PredictionExplanation: The parameter is assigned the argument passed during each call.
module.DebugPrompt: Add the parameter list, colons, and return values.
module.RecallPrompt: Rebuild check_temperature from memory. Use the exact identifier value. Use these exact values: 30, "Alarm", "Normal".
module.TransferPrompt: Create check_pressure(value) returning High above 80, otherwise Normal.
module.PreviewMessage: One function can now evaluate any supplied sensor reading.
